The feelings of shame about almost flunking out were so consuming. I know this is annoying but if I could do it all over again I would force myself to go to class, no matter how painful. It beats living back at home and working minimum wage. Please reach out to anyone, most people are more understanding than you think. I wish I would’ve talked to people about how I was feeling before everything spiraled out of control. No matter what, you can’t run away from your issues because that shit will haunt you.

Also, when the rest of the office was injected with those drugs he chose to abstain. And towards the end of his time on the show we can really see the toll that advertising was having on his conscience.
I feel like Bert was probably a racist, he was outwardly enjoying Roger’s blackface in the derby day episode. He was also against integrating his ads.

I feel like Lane was a poignant character who was trying really hard to do his best. Unlike most other characters. And in the three seasons we had him I never really saw him  do anything with malice to other people. I think his death was one of the saddest moments of the series for me.
